items.rationale: The indoor heating-pipe repair is covered under §2.4.3, and §7.1.7(c) covers like-for-like fittings. Four at €10.50 gross give €42.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers the separately specified repair fittings; the different model number does not establish duplication. Four at €10.50 gross give €42.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers like-for-like repair fittings. Five at about €20.80 gross give €104.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers these repair fittings. Five at about €20.60 gross give €103.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers this separately specified fitting. One at the reference gross rate gives €21.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers repair fasteners. Eight at approximately €1.16 gross give €9.30.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers repair fixings. Four at €4.80 gross give €19.20.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers repair fixings. Using the nearby clamp sizes as references, four at about €5.50 gross give €22.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers customary repair labour. The full 6.75 hours at about €93.30 gross per hour give €630.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers the helper's repair labour. The full 5.75 hours at about €71.10 gross per hour give €409.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(c) cover like-for-like pipe replacement. The 6.4 m billed at approximately €15.47 gross per metre give €99.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge for this contractor's invoice. One charge at the full-cover reference rate gives €82.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers installation consumables attributable to the repair. One flat rate at the comparable gross level gives €45.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separate processing and administrative charges. The €25 estimate is conditional only.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the original type of insulation. Six metres at €22.50 gross per metre give €135.

Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(c), (e) allow distinct repair material but exclude duplication or unsubstantiated use. If the mats are established as separate from line 15, six at about €20 gross give €120.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers wire used to secure the replacement insulation. Two at €13 gross give €26.

Section 7.1.7(g) covers repair labour, and the reported day and a half supports treating this as a separate block of time rather than a duplicate. Seven hours at approximately €93.15 gross per hour give €652.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows only the first travel charge for this contractor's invoice. The conditional amount for one otherwise eligible charge is €82.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes contractor protective equipment. The conditional estimate is €20 for one set.
Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of debris from the affected pipe and its repair. One flat charge at the reference level gives €60.

Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a) exclude hygiene and coating work not shown to be necessary to repair established tile damage. The same line in Case 18 was below €60 or unpaid, so €45 is a low-confidence conditional estimate.
